messages:
releasebot: deploybot detected elevated latency on service embeddings-backend (eu-west1). automatic health checks flagged p95 jump 120ms -> ~1.1s after last image promotion.
releasebot: Job: hotfix/embeddings-latency-1798504321. Suggested action: revert to image redwood/embeddings:2.3.9 and pin for short window. Requesting expedited approval to skip normal canary. Reply +1 to approve.

sheila: +1 from product. Support is already getting escalations. Keep release notes one-liner: "Revert quant kernel causing regression".

michael: +1. SRE here — preparing rollback playbook. If approved I'll trigger: `deploybot rollback hotfix/embeddings v2.3.9 --now --pin` and watch traces.

ops_oncall: I'm up. Curious about blast radius — is this eu-west1 only? Can we do staged pin to eu-west1 first? Prefer partial rollout if we have time, but if SLA is being breached we should expedite.

eng_lead: Data shows ~40% of production requests in eu-west1 hit the regression; many sessions experiencing timeouts at p95. Support/PGT recommends full pin in region. I approve expedited full pin for a 15m window. @ops_oncall please monitor infra during the rollback.

devex: I'll prep a brief release note and add to the release-notes doc: "Hotfix: revert embed quant path — restores p95 latency" and link to incident.

sre_lead: Runbook snippet for visibility:
```
# rollback steps
# 1. run rollback command
deploybot rollback hotfix/embeddings v2.3.9 --now --pin
# 2. wait for pods ready
kubectl rollout status deploy/embeddings --namespace=prod-eu-west1
# 3. observe tracing and p95 metrics
# 4. if errors spike -> coordinate rollback to blue/previous image
```

sheila: Support will send a short customer message once we confirm mitigation. Please post updates here :pray:.

michael: executing rollback now.

releasebot: deploybot: rollback started by michael at 1798504360. Tracking: https://deploys.internal/redwood/embeddings/1798504360

ops_oncall: draining old pods and bringing up revert image. Watching CPU/memory and LB health.

sre_lead: p95 back to ~130ms within ~80s of new pods passing readiness checks. Traces show cache warmup but no errors.

sheila: Confirmed with support: alerts cleared for impacted customers.

eng_lead: Good job. We'll keep the pin for 1h to ensure stability then reassess rollout plan for a safe re-release. Add the incident link to the release note.

releasebot: deploybot: rollback completed at 1798504412. Hotfix pinned to v2.3.9 in prod-eu-west1. Incident ticket: INC-2026-1243
